reading.title: PRINCE GEORGE'S COUNTY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORT Reference No.: CR-105-2023

candidates.quote: The Promise project will consist of 841 residential units of all types, including age-restricted senior units and over 100 affordable units at 65% of the Area Median Income (AMI).
The Promise project will consist of 841 residential units of all types, including age-restricted senior units and over 100 affordable units at 65% of the Area Median Income (AMI).
The resolution seeks the Council’s approval for a Payment in Lieu of Taxes (“PILOT”) for Petra’s the “Promise” project located at 1502 Southern Avenue in Oxon Hill.
candidates.wording: approval for a Payment in Lieu of Taxes

candidates.quote: The Policy Analysis and Fiscal Impact Statement indicates that based upon the tax assessment projections supplied by the Administration and using a two percent (2%) annual escalator, the execution of the contemplated PILOT agreements after the adoption of CR-105-2023 will result in an estimated thirty-three million dollars ($33M) in foregone real property tax revenue between 2027 and 2045 after accounting for the PILOT payments.
candidates.value: estimated thirty-three million dollars ($33M) in foregone real property tax revenue between 2027 and 2045
